response.justification: Bogdan has over 10 years of full-stack experience with strong alignment to the required stack (TypeScript, Node.js, React, Docker) and deep exposure to AI-agent infrastructure, cloud platforms (AWS), testing (Vitest/Jest equivalents), and architecture — plus demonstrable leadership in open-source and process improvement. His diverse background in embedded, web, and mobile systems showcases adaptability and systems thinking.
strengths: Extensive full-stack experience with TypeScript, Node.js, React, and Docker matching core stack requirements
Proven AI-agent infrastructure experience and contributions to agentic workflows (MCP code generators)
Strong track record in testing, CI/CD, and developer tooling with open-source projects and workshops
concerns: Limited explicit mention of Nest.js or Vitest in resume, though equivalent tools (Jest, GraphQL) are used
German language proficiency is only basic, which may impact collaboration in Berlin-based teams
Some roles use DLang or Java heavily — may raise questions about recent focus on TypeScript/Node.js ecosystem
